key.name: pocket-mode
key.summary: Pocket mode
key.description: While the proximity sensor is covered and it is dark for more than a second, the power key, double tap and notifications do not wake the screen and touches are ignored. Calls still wake it. Press the power key twice to wake anyway.

key.name: flip-to-silence
key.summary: Flip to silence
key.description: Face down and still for 1.5 s turns silent mode on; picking the phone up turns it off again (only if flip turned it on).

key.name: flip-silenced
key.summary: Internal: silent mode was turned on by flip to silence

key.name: raise-to-wake
key.summary: Raise to wake
key.description: Picking the phone up from rest into view turns the screen on (lock screen) while it is off; it goes off again after 10 s without a touch.

key.name: stay-on-while-held
key.summary: Stay on while held
key.description: A few seconds before the screen would dim for inactivity, the accelerometer is read for 1.5 s; if the phone is held in a reading pose (hand tremor, tilted, not flat or upside down, not covered) the screen stays on for another period. At most 10 minutes after the last touch. Nothing is read while this is off.
